_comment: Project-scoped Claude Code settings — copy to <project>/.claude/settings.json and
COMMIT it. Everyone working on the project gets the same behaviour.
This template is tuned for the kind of project audited by the repo-audit-fixer skill:
it makes the quality gate cheap to run and makes the destructive things impossible.
Machine-specific values belong in .claude/settings.local.json, which is gitignored.
NEVER put an API key, token or password in this file — it is committed.
Allow the project's own gate commands, so an audit or a review never stops to ask
permission to run the checks the project already defines.
Deny anything that rewrites history or reaches a remote without a human deciding.

_comment_audit: If this project is audited with the repo-audit-fixer skill, keep Reports/ COMMITTED.
The accumulated audit history is the point: it is what turns a returning defect into
a Critical regression finding rather than a fresh discovery. Do not gitignore it.
